name: shipmate
description: Delivers engineering work from Jira or local requirements, with reviews, walkthroughs and quizzes for Jira tickets and merge requests.

interface.longDescription: Five public actions—Specify, Run, Review, Walkthrough and Quiz—backed by internal engineering delivery procedures.
defaultPrompt: Use shipmate:specify to prepare a reviewed engineering contract.
Use shipmate:run to deliver Jira or local requirements to a verified draft MR.
Use shipmate:review to challenge a specification, plan or candidate.
Use shipmate:walkthrough to explain this Jira ticket or merge request in layers.
Use shipmate:quiz to check my understanding of this Jira ticket or merge request and show a report.
